verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph lets services running outside the Teams UI automate Teams: creating teams and channels, configuring them, and posting channel messages. Incoming webhooks also post messages from external services. The official Agents Toolkit CLI covers app creation, provisioning, deployment, validation, packaging and publishing from the command line, which suits scripted pipelines. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents CI usage or non-interactive auth, and a community report notes integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack rather than simple webhooks. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless/service-principal auth guidance for automation, hands-on corroboration of CI usage, lighter-weight automation path without the Azure/Graph stack
